title_en: Reply of the Supreme People's Court on Approving the Abolition of the Nanjing Railway Transport Court and the Establishment of the Nanjing Maritime Court
full_text_en:
Supreme People's Court

Reply on Approving the Abolition of Nanjing Railway Transport Court and the Establishment of Nanjing Maritime Court

Fa [2019] No. 39

Jiangsu High People's Court:

Your court's "Request for Instructions on Establishing Nanjing Maritime Court" (Su Gao Fa [2018] No. 233) and "Supplementary Report on Matters Related to the Abolition of Nanjing Railway Transport Court and Establishment of Nanjing Maritime Court" (Su Gao Fa [2019] No. 26) have been received and reviewed. Upon review, the following reply is given:

1. It is agreed to abolish Nanjing Railway Transport Court and establish Nanjing Maritime Court.

2. Nanjing Maritime Court shall be organized as an intermediate people's court, with its higher-level court being the Jiangsu High People's Court. Relevant judicial positions shall be appointed and removed by the Standing Committee of the Jiangsu Provincial People's Congress.

3. The institutional establishment, number of internal organs, and leadership positions of Nanjing Maritime Court shall be implemented in accordance with the "Reply of the Central Organization Establishment Commission on Establishing Nanjing Maritime Court" (Central Organization Establishment Commission Fu [2019] No. 5).

The official seal of Nanjing Railway Transport Court shall be retrieved and destroyed by your court, and the official seal of Nanjing Maritime Court shall be issued by our court.

February 18, 2019
